notes.title: Version 1.1.1_240907
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130161/e6769c8f12e43fefd5c43ab97cbbeecb5a93664f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130161/6b5ca03904ddecbae6fcaee791c11a7f0fe266ad.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130161/d2bb45e9534b46f0ff4e1fa79e15dd4841901daa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130161/4b4ab6b4ee81490d7852acffc9b8e6ebd742f1bb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130161/e30520410d8ca952c77ff8d50028355acbd43f09.gif[/img]
1. 修复鸭鸭一直往右走的BUG
2. 夏小亚魔法阵现在可以治疗宠物了
3. 古怪森林加入了被“囚禁的射手座牢笼”，打破可以获得此宠物
4. 减少技能“矿役J的轰炸”的烟雾
5. 矿洞加入了回声音效
6. 加入了对英文的支持
7. 制作了队伍系统，可以带上两个队友一起出战。
8. 取消了鼠标右键双击也会触发切换自动攻击的设定
9. 成员可以拾取“心”道具恢复血量
10. 成员随机带着几个复活包出场。
11. “小凯”骑乘时阻止在有地形的区域下落
12. 加入各角色的语音
13. 更新了近400条英语翻译
14. 加入了语言切换系统
14. 本打算废除抽卡机制，转成是完全可视化的实体探索。但因看到低质量用户说自己反感游戏内有抽卡，于是我故意保留了抽卡这种机制。
15. 游戏价格提高了。（是为了筛选掉低质量玩家，它们教会了我如何“宁缺毋滥”）
16. 加入了功能较多的社区营地地图（集合了社区居委会的功能，并且所有角色都会在篝火周围休息）
17. 加入了显示任务物品和未知事件的方位箭头。
18. 一些场景中会有囚禁的成员，可以通过钥匙或者强硬破坏的方式来解救这些成员。
19. 游戏内封禁了一名玩家ID
20. 修复了小量神奇的BUG（视觉上和一些小问题）。
21. 队伍中的小伙伴继承技能卡牌效果似乎会影响到中低端电脑的流畅性，因此去掉了小伙伴的技能发射器。
22. 将部分需要用GPU的粒子的效果转成CPU。
23. 夜少雨有很低的概率出现在神秘天塔里。
24. 在游戏帧数低于60时经验球不会掉落，而是直接添加到玩家的经验条里。
25. 在帧数低于60时会关闭部分特效画面
26. 在帧数低于60时会停止部分音效。
27. 怪物在死亡之后不会立即删除，改用延迟删除（避免在一瞬间杀死大量怪物时造成卡顿过久的问题）
28. 暂停菜单中加入了”命中停顿“和”自动游戏“的功能选项
29. 修复部分地图损坏导致崩溃的问题
30. 新增了地图“和平草原”
31. 新增了一个“猪脑小作坊”的物品商店界面，用于购买驯服宠物的必备道具。
32. 在“和平草原”里时，屏幕底下会显示物品数量
33. 重做了资源加载系统，场景切换会显示加载进度。
34. 制作了一辆可以驾驶的小汽车，方便更快的探索“和平草原”。
35. “和平草原”会在随机位置生成随机物品，这些物品用于驯服宠物，靠近宠物按[E]丢出物品。
36. “和平草原”会在随机位置生成随机宠物，可使用[Tab] 键查看驯服宠物需要的用品。
37. 制作了全局属性加点面板的菜单。
38. 补充了一条“攻击范围”的属性显示。
39. “额外伤害”属性卡牌不再对技能生效。
40. 社区营地里加入了一个稻草人用于打开属性升级页面
41. 新增加了一个BOSS“革命大杀器”
42. 给革命大杀器入了一些随机语音
43. 修复馨的提示信息。
44. 现在默认隐藏属性面板（隐藏属性面板可以极大的提高游戏流畅度）
45. Steam社区里加入了单局杀怪排行榜
46. Steam社区里加入了单局等级排行榜
47. 去除社区快捷探索的保底系统

48. 修复容易闪退的问题（来自shader导致的闪退）
49. 修复了加载时的流畅度和更稳定的卸载场景顺序。

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 (Community Campsite..)
notes.content:
1. Fix the bug that Ducks always walk to the right
2. Xia Xiaoya's magic circle can now heal pets
3. The Weird Forest has joined the "Imprisoned Sagittarius Cage", breaking the barrier to obtain this pet
4. Reduce the smoke of the skill "Mining J's Bombardment"
5. The sound effect of echo has been added to the mine
6. Added support for English
7. A team system has been created, allowing players to bring two teammates to battle together.
8. The setting that double-clicking with the right mouse button will trigger the switch to automatic attack has been removed
9. Members can pick up the "Heart" item to restore health
10. Members will appear with several resurrection packs at random.
11. When riding, "Xiaokai" should be prevented from falling in areas with terrain
12. Add voice for each character
13. Nearly 400 English translations have been updated
14. Added language switching system
14. The intention was to abolish the card-drawing mechanism and turn it into a fully visualized physical exploration.But seeing that low-quality users said they were disgusted with the card-drawing mechanism in the game, I deliberately retained this mechanism.
The price of the game has increased.(To filter out low-quality players, they taught me how to "choose the best over the worst")
16. Added a community camp map with more functions (collecting the functions of the community neighborhood committee, and all characters will rest around the campfire)
17. Added orientation arrows to show mission items and unknown events.
18. Some scenes will have imprisoned members, who can be rescued by keys or hard-to-break methods.
19. A player ID was banned in the game
20. Fixed a small number of magical bugs (visually and some minor issues).
21. The effect of inheriting skill cards from teammates seems to affect the fluency of low-end computers, so the skill launcher for teammates has been removed.
22. Convert some GPU-required particle effects to CPU.
23. There is a low probability of rain at night in the mysterious sky tower.
24. When the game frame rate is lower than 60, the experience ball will not drop, but will be directly added to the player's experience bar.
25. When the frame rate falls below 60, certain special effects will be turned off
26. Some sound effects will stop when the frame rate is lower than 60.
27. Monsters will not be deleted immediately after death, but will instead be deleted with a delay (to avoid causing a long lag when killing a large number of monsters in an instant)
28. The pause menu has added the function options of "hit pause" and "automatic game"
29. Fixed the crash caused by some map corruption
30. A new map, "Peaceful Grassland", has been added
31. Added a new item store interface for the "small pig brain workshop" to purchase necessary props for taming pets.
32. When in the "Peaceful Grassland", the number of items will be displayed at the bottom of the screen
33. The resource loading system has been reworked, and the loading progress will be displayed during scene switching.
A small car that can be driven has been made to facilitate faster exploration of the "peaceful grassland".
35. "Peaceful Grassland" will generate random items at random locations. These items are used to tame pets. Press [E] to throw the item near the pet.
36. "Peaceful Grassland" will generate random pets at random locations. You can use the [Tab] key to view the supplies needed to tame the pets.
37. A menu for the global attribute point addition panel has been created.
38. An additional attribute of "attack range" has been added.
39. The "Additional Damage" attribute card no longer works on skills.
40. A scarecrow has been added to the community camp to open the property upgrade page
41. A new BOSS "revolutionary killer" has been added
42. Put some random voice into the revolutionary killer
43. Fix the prompt information of Xin.
44. The property panel is now hidden by default (hiding the property panel can greatly improve the game's fluency)
45. The Steam community has added a single-round monster killing leaderboard
46. The Steam community has added a single-round ranking leaderboard
47. Remove the guaranteed system for fast exploration in the community

notes.title: Game Price Adjustment
notes.content:
下个版本将会有较大体量大的更新。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130161/5c069687ad2e1c4116d768218ba62be737075a93.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130161/f15a1de7befcbb4e6ed9d1398930a2d422b76311.jpg[/img]
The pricing adjustment was made to filter out low-quality players who would otherwise consume my patience and mood with minimal cost.

Upcoming Version Update Preview:

Fixed the bug where Ducky consistently walks to the right.
Xiaoxia's Magic Circle can now heal pets.
Introduced the "Imprisoned Sagittarius Cage" in the Weird Forest. Breaking it frees this pet.
Reduced the smoke effect of the "Mining Labor J's Bombardment" skill.
Added echo sound effects to the mines.
Added support for English language.
Implemented a team system, allowing players to bring two teammates into battle.
Removed the right-click double-tap function that triggered auto-attack switching.
Members can now pick up "Heart" items to restore health.
Members randomly spawn with several revival packs.
"Xiaokai" riding is prevented from descending in areas with terrain.
Incorporated voiceovers for each character.
Internationalized language support.
Introduced the Community Camp World.
Increased the game price. (This is to filter out low-quality players, who have taught me the value of "quality over quantity.")
Added a feature-rich Community Camp map, incorporating functions of a community committee, where all characters rest around a campfire.
Implemented directional arrows showing the location of quest items and unknown events.
In some scenarios, imprisoned members can be rescued through keys or forceful methods.
Banned a player ID within the game.
Fixed a small number of magical bugs (visual and minor issues).
Removed skill card effect emitters from companions to prevent lag on low- to mid-range computers, as inheriting these effects seemed to affect performance.
...

Updates are ongoing, primarily focused on the Community Camp and a complete overhaul of all UI interfaces. These changes replace "UI Exploration" with more visual and tangible entity manipulation, though the UI Exploration feature remains optional for players who prefer exploration over combat, enhancing the reasonable of organizing exploration teams.
